text:
maya: Quick heads-up — after promoting cobalt-13b-q5 to canary (10% traffic) we’re seeing two flaky things: repeated short fragments in ~0.8% of responses, and tail latency spikes for sequences >512 tokens (+200-400ms).

alex: Can you share a short example of the repeat and the model config you used? infra type?

maya: Example prompt/response (sanitized):
```
User: Summarize the email thread about the meeting.
Model: You received the agenda and the notes. You received the agenda and the notes. Then follow-up action items...
```
Config: `cobalt-13b-q5`, quant profile `q5-symmetric-8`, KV cache enabled, `fused_attn: auto`, hardware `p4d.24xlarge` (us-west-2 canary pool).

maya: Quick perf dump: p50=42ms p95=120ms p99=310ms for short prompts, but for >512 tokens we’re seeing p99 ~720-900ms on canary shards; baseline (q4) p99 ~480ms.

santiago: Repetition looks like KV cache rewind / partial duplication boundary — could be a quant-decoder tokenization edge where logits for certain ids get split across fused kernels. Any reproducible seed?

maya: Repro script attached (ran locally on a canary VM):
```
python run_repro.py --model cobalt-13b-q5 --prompt examples/repro_repeat.txt --seed 42 --max-tokens 256
```
Ran 50 inferences, saw 3 repeats.

alex: Can you dump the raw logits around the repeat span (token ids +/- 8) and the KV cache size delta? That would help check whether the model is emitting near-identical topk leading to duplication.

jess: We saw similar duplication when switching to symmetric quant tables in q5 on earlier experiments — sometimes top1 logit separation collapses for certain tokens after rounding. Suggest try `--quant-relax=1` to loosen bucket boundaries and repro.

maya: Will run quant-relax and also try forcing `fused_attn: v2` (we currently have auto).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary autoscaler observed error rate increase and latency degradation. Initiating automated rollback for cobalt-13b-q5 on canary at ts=1729999000.

alex: Good — we should freeze canary while we investigate. Maya, please capture a heap/profile from the slow tail requests (perf top / nvprof) and upload to #eng-infra.

eval-bot: Quick eval summary: long-form benchmark (LongBench-v2) shows perplexity +2.3% vs q4 baseline on >512 token split; short-form metrics unchanged. Also small uptick in token repetition metric (rep-grams) from 0.5% to 1.3% on sampled logs.

santiago: If quant-relax reproduces fewer repeats, we can re-generate a quant table with tweak on bucket boundaries. If not, we should bisect fused-attn kernel versions.

maya: Plan: (1) run quant-relax + fused_attn=v2 tests (2) dump logits + kv deltas for failures (3) re-run eval-bot suite on the failing samples (4) if confirmed, revert q5 quant table and re-upload telemetry to infra. I’ll post results here in ~90m.

jess: Ping me when you have the logits; I can run a quick simulation of rounding noise. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — updating the canary thread and adding ticket ML-1724 for follow-up.
